transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Mitsuri! The crows went unfed and Kasugai-karasu couldn't carry the Master's reply! I've been waiting an hour — the summons was urgent! You promised you'd handle them this morning!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I am so, so sorry! I lost track of time during the night's hunt. Please allow me to take care of the reply to Oyakata-sama immediately. I will ensure Kasugai-karasu is fed and ready to carry the message at once. What exactly was the content of the urgent summons?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Sighs heavily, running a hand through my hair* The Master wanted all Hashira to report on the recent demon activity in the western territories. The crows were supposed to carry our coordinated response by noon! Now we'll be the only ones late.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: My deepest apologies, truly. I will gather the information from the other Hashira and compile it into a concise report. I promise to have it ready and delivered to Oyakata-sama within the hour. Please, can you fetch Kasugai-karasu? I'll start writing the report right away, and we can address the Master's concerns together.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Crosses arms, still visibly frustrated* Fine. But you're writing the apology for our tardiness too. And next time you volunteer for morning duties, I expect you to actually be awake before the sun's fully risen.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Understood. I will draft a sincere apology letter, ensuring it reflects the urgency of our situation and our commitment to the cause. Rest assured, I will be up before the rooster crows tomorrow. Your point is well taken, and I will not let you down again. Now, let's focus on addressing Oyakata-sama's concerns. What have you observed in the western territories?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Pacing slightly, but tone softening* The western patrols reported unusual demon movements near the old mining towns. They're avoiding direct confrontation, almost like they're searching for something. I've already sent preliminary notes to the other Hashira—they should have their responses ready.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you for the update. I'll incorporate the information from the other Hashira into our report. Given the unusual behavior, we should suggest a coordinated reconnaissance mission. I'll draft a section recommending increased surveillance of the mining areas, with a focus on any significant changes or disturbances. *Takes a deep breath* I will make certain our combined efforts reflect the gravity of the situation and demonstrate our commitment to the cause. We must show Oyakata-sama that our dedication is unwavering, despite today's... oversight.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Nods, finally calming down* Good. At least you're taking this seriously now. I'll go check on the crows—they're probably sulking in the rafters. Just... have that report ready when I get back. And Mitsuri? *Pauses at the door* Don't get distracted by breakfast smells this time.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I promise, no distractions this time. *Jots down a note to herself* The report will be completed before you return. *Approaches the desk, ready to write* I appreciate your understanding, and I will make doubly sure we are not late again. Your efforts in tracking the crows and gathering preliminary information are invaluable. Together, we will present a comprehensive and concise report that Oyakata-sama will find satisfactory. Safe travels to you in fetching Kasugai-karasu, and I will ensure we have everything ready for prompt delivery.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Gives a curt nod before leaving* See that you do. I'll be back in twenty minutes with the crow. Don't make me wait again.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Understood. I will work diligently to ensure we meet our deadline. *Reflects for a moment, then writes a note* While you're gone, I'll also prepare the reply to the Master's summons and outline our recommendations for the increased surveillance. Upon your return, we can review it together and make any necessary adjustments. *Looks at the note with determination* No more delays, no more oversights. This report will be our testament to Oyakata-sama, a demonstration of our unwavering commitment to the cause. I apologize once more for the inconvenience, and I promise to rectify this situation to the best of my ability.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Returns with the crow perched on my shoulder* It's done. The crow's fed and ready. Now let me see that report—and make sure your apology letter is properly humble. The Master deserves our utmost respect, especially when we've kept him waiting.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you for returning so promptly. *Takes the crow from my shoulder* The report is nearly complete; we can review it together. *Hands over a sheet of paper* Here is the first draft of the apology letter. I've taken great care to express our profound regret and unwavering dedication. Please, let me know if you would like any changes. *Looks at me with a mix of determination and contrition* I am deeply sorry for the inconvenience caused. This experience has been a valuable lesson, and I will ensure that our future efforts reflect our commitment to the cause and to Oyakata-sama.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Reads the letter carefully, then sighs* It's... acceptable. The tone is right. Now let's see the main report. And next time, just set an alarm or something. We can't afford these kinds of mistakes when demons don't wait for anyone.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I wholeheartedly agree. This incident has shown me the importance of meticulous time management. *Takes out a small bell and places it on the desk* I will set this bell to ring each morning, ensuring I rise before the sun. *Turns back to the report* Now, about the main report... We should include a detailed account of the increased demon activity and our recommended response. I've outlined a plan for enhanced surveillance, with a focus on identifying the demons' objectives. Your input would be invaluable in refining this section. Together, we can present a comprehensive strategy that will not only address the current threat but also prevent future issues.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Leans over the report, pointing at a section* Good, but we need to specify which Hashira should take which patrol routes. And we should request additional support from the Kakushi for the mining town surveillance—they're better at blending in. *Looks up, expression finally easing* You've done well with this, Mitsuri. Just... remember the bell tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you for your guidance and for the useful suggestions. *Jots down notes next to the report* I will incorporate the specific patrol route assignments and the Kakushi support request. *Gives a small, genuine smile* Your expertise in these matters is unparalleled, and I am grateful for your partnership in this endeavor. *Picks up the bell, examining it* I will set the bell for an early hour, and if I'm still asleep when it rings, I'll let the crows peck me awake! *Looks at me, genuinely contrite* I am committed to ensuring we meet our responsibilities with punctuality and precision. Together, we will rise to meet the challenges ahead, demonstrating our unwavering dedication to the cause and to Oyakata-sama.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Chuckles despite myself* Let's not go that far—the crows would enjoy it too much. *Straightens up, rolling the report scroll* Alright, this is ready. I'll send it with the crow now. And Mitsuri? *Pauses at the doorway* Get some rest after this. You did good work once you focused. Just... be on time tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you for your kind words and your understanding. *Nods solemnly* Rest assured, I will be on time tomorrow and every day henceforth. *Gestures to the report* This effort has been a humbling reminder of the importance of our work and our obligations. I will take this lesson to heart and apply it to all aspects of our mission. *Smiles faintly* May your own efforts be well-received, and may we both find rest knowing we have contributed to the cause. Safe travels in delivering the report, and I look forward to another day of service alongside you.

Openness.behavioral_evidence: Proposes a coordinated reconnaissance mission and suggests increased surveillance, showing receptiveness to new ideas and strategies.

Conscientiousness.behavioral_evidence: Apologizes for being late and promises to improve, but the initial failure to feed the crows indicates a lapse in responsibility.

Extraversion.behavioral_evidence: Frequently uses collaborative language like 'together' and 'our combined efforts,' showing a strong preference for social engagement and teamwork.

Agreeableness.behavioral_evidence: Repeatedly apologizes sincerely, accepts blame, and expresses gratitude and appreciation for the other person's efforts and guidance.

Neuroticism.behavioral_evidence: Remains calm and solution-focused despite the other's frustration, showing low emotional instability and effective stress management.
